call back · /ˌkɔl ˈbæk/ · verb phrase · Phrase · New
to phone someone again or return their phone call. Can you call back at four?
leave a message · /ˌliv ə ˈmɛsɪdʒ/ · verb phrase · Phrase · New
to give someone information to pass on or hear later. Please leave a message after the sound.
a system that records a caller's spoken message when someone cannot answer. Her phone goes to voicemail.
hang up · /ˌhæŋ ˈʌp/ · verb phrase · Phrase · New
to end a phone call. Say goodbye before you hang up.
